component.name: Trove
component.summary: Fast file explorer with real tabs

description.p: Trove is a fast file explorer with real tabs and one look on Windows, Mac and Ubuntu.

ul.li: Press Ctrl K to find anything; a search index finds files by name at once
Spotlight: a small window on a shortcut that finds files and apps and does sums
See each folder's size, counted in the background
Open zip, 7z and tar files like folders, extract them and make new ones
A terminal pane that starts your own shell
